text:
My secret? It is so sad! I am lost

in love with a vanished being,

with a freed soul,

who for ten years was mine, and who has gone...

My secret? I will tell it in your ear:

I am in love with a dead woman!


Do you understand—you who seek the visible

transports, the real, the tangible

caresses of the woman who takes shape

for all your invincible desires—

that impossible of impossibles:

to adore a ghost?


Well, such is my life and such has it been

and will be!

If for me alone

her noble heart beat, now silent and frozen,

must I show myself ungrateful

and forget her, merely because she has departed,

and leave her, merely because she has died?

translation.title: My Secret? It Is So Sad! I Am Lost...
translation.editorial_note: This first-line variant keeps the whispered confession and ghostly fidelity.
